Id=vesktop.service
Description=Vesktop (Discord)
FragmentPath=/home/bandit/.config/systemd/user/vesktop.service
ExecStart={ path=/usr/bin/vesktop ; argv[]=/usr/bin/vesktop ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }

Id=tmux.service
Description=tmux server
FragmentPath=/home/bandit/.config/systemd/user/tmux.service
ExecStart={ path=/usr/bin/tmux ; argv[]=/usr/bin/tmux new-session -d ; ignore_errors=no }

Id=spotify-spare.service
Description=Spotify, spare
FragmentPath=/home/bandit/.config/systemd/user/spotify-spare.service
ExecStart={ path=/usr/bin/spotify ; argv[]=/usr/bin/spotify ; ignore_errors=no }

Id=wireplumber.service
Description=Multimedia Service Session Manager
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/user/wireplumber.service
ExecStart={ path=/usr/bin/foot ; argv[]=/usr/bin/foot ; ignore_errors=no }

Id=syncthing.service
Description=Syncthing - Open Source Continuous File Synchronization
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/user/syncthing.service
ExecStart={ path=/usr/bin/syncthing ; argv[]=/usr/bin/syncthing serve ; ignore_errors=no }
